title: Exercise below plan or musculoskeletal pain
source: CrewCare team, FICTIONAL document created for the NASA Space Apps 2026 demonstration. Not from a clinical source.

approval.note: FICTIONAL PROTOCOL, NOT APPROVED. Used only to demonstrate the application workflow. Not for medical decisions.

summary: Documenting reasons for reduced exercise and reporting musculoskeletal pain.

sections.heading: When it applies
sections.body: Rule R-EXERCISE-BELOW-USUAL is active, or pain in the back, arms or legs is reported.

sections.heading: Steps (fictional)
sections.body:
1. Record the reason for less exercise (pain, schedule, equipment).
2. Record where and when the pain started.
3. Do not resume heavy-load exercise until the CMO has reviewed it.
4. The CMO may ask the ground team for an adapted exercise plan.
